_purpose: Readiness plan Steps 2, 3 and 6 (feasibility). One file holds every scientific setting used by 3D_Code/readiness/kit.py. Keys starting with '_' are documentation.

_sources.conductivityRatios: Roberts and Scher 1982 Circ Res 50:342-351 (canine LV): sigma_il 0.344, sigma_it 0.060, sigma_el 0.117, sigma_et 0.080 S/m; transversely isotropic (n = t). DL-2026-10-28-04.
_sources.cvTarget: 0.90 m/s along fibres (DL-2026-10-28-03; van Schie et al. 2021). Sensitivity 0.70 and 1.25 m/s.
_sources.tuningRule: sigma_i and sigma_e multiplied by (CV_target / CV)^2 each iteration, ratios fixed: openCARP example 02_EP_tissue/03A_study_prep_tuneCV.
_sources.benchmark: Niederer et al. 2011 Phil Trans R Soc A 369:4331-4351 (doi:10.1098/rsta.2011.0139); parameter blocks copied from openCARP example 02_EP_tissue/03G_study_resolution. Stimulus 50000 uA/cm^3 / chi 1400 cm^-1 = 35.71 uA/cm^2 transmembrane.
_sources.blood: 0.74 S/m (135 ohm cm), Traugott, Quail and White 1981.
_sources.tolerances: DL-2026-10-28-05 (CV 2 %, PP 5 %, FOV80 0.5 mm, change point 0.5 mm; MPI activation 0.02 ms, Vm 0.1 mV, phie PP 0.1 %).

cvTuning._initialScale: Starting multiplier for the base set. ASSUMPTION/estimate from the pilot (CV 0.352 m/s at monodomain sigma_l 0.136 S/m, 0.5 mm): (0.90/0.352)^2 * 0.136 / 0.0873 = 10.2. Only saves iterations; the result does not depend on it.
cvTuning._tuningTolerance: ASSUMPTION: 1 %, half the 2 % CV convergence tolerance so tuning error does not use up the convergence budget.
cvTuning._measurement: CV = 1 / |grad t| from a least-squares plane fit to last-beat activation times (-20 mV upward crossing, openCARP LAT) of all nodes with propagation coordinate in measureRangeMm. Planar wave along the strip; 5 mm clear of the stimulus and of the far end.
cvTuning._captureRule: If a tuning run does not activate the measurement range in every beat, the strength is doubled and the run repeated, at most twice per tuning (50 -> 100 -> 200 uA/cm^2). CV is measured 5 mm or more from the stimulus, on the last beat. The strength that captured at the target CV is recorded and used for every later strip, ladder and bath run; each sensitivity set records its own.

niederer._note: Corner of the benchmark at the mesher-centred coordinate (-10, -3.5, -1.5) mm. Activation threshold 0 mV, as in the benchmark.

ladder._reducedDomain: 40 x 30 x 4 mm: pilot length along propagation (stimulus-to-grid distance unchanged), half the pilot width across the boundary. ASSUMPTION that discretisation error measured here transfers to the full slab; the domain runs test domain size separately.
ladder._beats: ASSUMPTION: 4 tissue beats after 1000 single-cell conditioning beats (pilot: 16). The physiology stability check on beats 2-4 and the 4-vs-8-beat run test it.
ladder._window: PROPOSED (DL-2026-10-28-08): per run, from intact last-beat activation of top-surface nodes under the grid (|x| <= 6.5 mm): start = max(first - 15, stimulus end + 5) ms, end = last + 30 ms after the beat stimulus. Margins reproduce DL-2026-10-27-01 on the pilot (39.3 -> 24.3 ms; 73.4 -> 103.4 ms). Fixed before any EGM is measured.

bath._purpose: Step 6 feasibility only: does openCARP pseudo-bidomain with a blood bath run on this build, and does its phi_e equal an independent finite-element solve of the same discrete problem? Not a production configuration.
bath._ground: Extracellular ground (stimulus type 3, 0 mV) on the top face of the bath, the face farthest from the tissue.
bath._tolerance: PROPOSED: openCARP vs independent FEM phi_e at electrode samples, relative RMS <= 1 % per signal and correlation >= 0.9999 (same mesh, same discrete system; differences should be at solver tolerance).
